_comment: The five standard roles. A permission pattern ending in :% means every action of that module (create, read, update, delete). Applied to an organisation by the migration 20261111120000_role_templates; an administrator can still edit any role afterwards.

roles.name: Administrator
roles.description: Full access to everything, including users, roles, commission percentages and payroll approval.

roles.name: Account Manager
roles.description: Clients, vacancies, applications and the candidates assigned to them.

roles.name: Resourcer
roles.description: The candidate database, jobs and their own placements. Cannot see other people's commission.

roles.name: Payroll Administrator
roles.description: Timesheets, payroll, payslips and payment statuses. May approve payroll and see NINO and UTR.
